text: On the Moon, the link with Earth can drop. And getting home takes three to eleven days.
Moon Care keeps the data from every device on board. No connection to Earth needed.
Every morning you see how you slept, your heart, your radiation.
One day, seven readings shift together: a possible infection.
A voice guides the medical officer through NASA's checklist, and writes the report.
When the link returns, Earth receives it all.
Not just to reach the Moon. To live there.
